verdict: Organic visibility dropped sharply this week; recovery steps are in motion.
narrative: Across all three businesses this period, Google Business Profile was the sole active channel, generating a combined 373 total actions — 13 calls, 271 direction requests, and 89 website clicks — with no paid spend running on any platform. Engagement held reasonably across the full 28 days, but the final 3 days of the period (Oct 1–3) showed a near-complete stop in both profile actions and organic search clicks across Forte and Advance Grinding, while O'Hare saw a strong mid-period surge before stalling in the same window. The search click drop is consistent with a local visibility issue, not seasonal patterns, and the phone listings on two O'Hare profiles — Precision Ground Metals and Precision Ground Bars — are being audited now after recording zero calls despite meaningful impressions all period. Outreach sequences and CRM data pipelines are being unblocked this month, which will add pipeline activity that organic alone cannot currently provide; the October milestone targets cover reindexing, lapsed-customer sequences, and automation go-live across all brands.

watch_item.issue: Google Business Profile actions and organic search clicks fell to near zero across Forte and Advance Grinding in the last 3 days of the period, and two O'Hare profiles recorded zero calls despite consistent impressions all month.
watch_item.fix: A local visibility audit is underway across all profiles, phone listings on the two silent O'Hare profiles are being verified, and site reindexing is targeted for completion by end of October.
